provenance.source_citation: NCES, 'Mapping State Proficiency Standards Onto the NAEP Scales: Results From the 2022 NAEP Reading and Mathematics Assessments' (NCES 2026-014), Table 3. Mathematics grade 4: NAEP Basic 214, NAEP Proficient 249, NAEP Advanced 282; grade 8: 262 / 299 / 333. Cuts 'maintained with no changes since their establishment in the early 1990s.' https://nces.ed.gov/nationsreportcard/subject/publications/studies/pdf/2026014.pdf
provenance.changed_from_prior: New sidecar for the 2019 administration (SGPc delivery is grade 8 mathematics). Same NAEP mathematics cuts as naep-us-2015.

design.notes: Matrix (booklet) item sampling. The SGPc delivery for this year is grade 8 mathematics (jurisdiction-level weighted marginal quantile arrays with the national-equivalent percentile). Design fields match the 2015 NAEP mathematics composite (MRPCM / ORIGWT / JK1 62).

enrollment.note: NAEP 2019 also assessed grade 12; not in the SGPc delivery. The SGPc 2019 file is grade 8. NAEP mathematics is not vertically equated across grades.

MATHEMATICS.notes: NCES currently styles the three reporting levels 'NAEP Basic', 'NAEP Proficient', 'NAEP Advanced'; the floor below the Basic cut is reported as below Basic. Labels kept in the ADR-013 draft shape. proficient_from = Proficient is the NCES 'at or above Proficient' reporting line, not a state policy target.

4.notes: NAEP mathematics grades 4 and 8 are reported on a 0-500 scale (NCES 2026-014 Table 3 note). Not a vertical scale.

8.notes: NAEP mathematics grades 4 and 8 are reported on a 0-500 scale (NCES 2026-014 Table 3 note). Not a vertical scale.

cutscores_provenance: MATHEMATICS only (maintainer first-pass). Same cuts as naep-us-2015: grade 4 Basic 214 / Proficient 249 / Advanced 282; grade 8 262 / 299 / 333. NCES 2026-014 Table 3 states the NAEP mathematics/reading cut scores have been unchanged since the early-1990s achievement-level setting. Human promotes to reviewed (A3.4 gate).
notes: First-pass scope is MATHEMATICS. Grade-12 NAEP mathematics uses a different 0-300 scale and is not authored here.
